Call the vtable entry at offset +4 of the object: (*(vtable+4))(object, 0, a4) to initialize it.
When the vtable dispatch result is not -1, return 1 (success).
VirtualCleanup(this) destroys the object via its vtable and nulls the slot after failed construction or initialization.
Return 0 when the slot was already set, allocation failed, or initialization failed.
